incidents.name: Our Engineers are Investigating an Issue with Voice Insights
incidents.message: The customer impact of a retroactive issue with Voice Insights for Call Summaries in the US region has been resolved and is operating normally at this time.

incidents.name: SMS Delivery Delays to Roshan/TDCA Network in Afghanistan
incidents.message: We are no longer experiencing SMS delivery delays when sending messages to Roshan/TDCA Network in Afghanistan. This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: SMS Delivery Delays to Asia Cell Networks in Iraq
incidents.message: We are no longer experiencing SMS delivery delays when sending messages to Asia Cell Networks in Iraq. This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: SMS Delivery Delays to MobiFone Network in Vietnam via a Subset of Long Code Numbers & Alphanumeric Senders
incidents.message: We are no longer experiencing SMS delivery delays to MobiFone network in Vietnam via a subset of long code numbers & alphanumeric senders. This incident has been resolved.
